svg.title: Lanternwater Halls — Roofless lantern rooms
svg.desc: Three roofless rooms hold dry encounter floors. Balconies connect fuel parcels above flooded side aisles; benches and broken shelves make a layered return route. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Three roofless rooms hold dry encounter floors. Balconies connect fuel parcels above
flooded side aisles; benches and broken shelves make a layered return route.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
P1 Mangrove Channels · P2 Reefsong Current · P3 Floodhall Passage
Encounter: Silt Skitter · Common; repeatable solo combat AND equivalent aid/repair objective.
DESIGN-0014 / DESIGN-0022 / DESIGN-0023 · MAP ATLAS / SEPTEMBER 2026
